h2: Handyman Kuta & Legian – Small Repairs, One Visit
intro: Living or running a property along Kuta Beach or down in Tuban means dealing with doors that stick after monsoon season, handles corroding near the salt air, and bathroom silicone that simply gives up. As your Handyman Kuta & Legian service, Bali Fix bundles all those little fixes into a single visit so you're not chasing five different tradespeople for jobs that take an hour each.

sections.h3: Why Kuta's Older Streets Need Regular Tinkering
sections.text: The salt-laden air off Kuta Beach eats through metal hinges, lock cylinders and curtain rails within a couple of seasons. Behind the walls of older guesthouses in this stretch, decades of daily use means doors stick, screens warp, and bathroom silicone cracks open. None of these call for a renovation crew—they're one-visit fixes that keep your property running without juggling multiple contractors.

sections.h3: What We Typically Fix Around Legian and Tuban
sections.text: In Legian and Tuban we see the same list week after week: a bedroom door rubbing its frame after timber swells in wet season; a pool-house lock seized by corrosion; a mosquito screen torn at the corner; a re-siliconing job on a walk-in shower; a floating shelf needing re-drilling into older plasterboard; or a TV bracket that has shifted. If it fits in a toolbox and takes under three hours, it belongs in this visit.

sections.h3: Sending Photos on WhatsApp for a Quick Quote
sections.text: Snap a few clear photos from WhatsApp—close-up of the sticking hinge, the corroded handle, the cracked silicone line—and send them with a short note like 'door sticks when closed' or 'shower tray weeping.' A photo plus two words is usually enough for us to confirm whether it's a quick fix or something needing a replacement part. You'll get a straightforward quote back before anyone shows up at your villa.

sections.h3: Small Habits That Save You Bigger Calls Later
sections.text: A little maintenance goes far in this climate. Wipe down metal fittings near Kuta Beach every dry season with a clean cloth to slow corrosion. Re-check door hinges and screen frames right after each monsoon, because humidity swells timber fast. In guesthouses with multiple bathrooms, run a finger along the silicone joints quarterly—if it's lifting or mouldy, book a re-siliconing before water reaches the substrate underneath. Small attention now means fewer warped doors and hidden leaks later.

faq.q: Do you cover areas beyond Kuta and Legian?
faq.a: Yes—we regularly work in Tuban and around Kuta Beach as well. If your property sits within that stretch, just message us on WhatsApp and we'll confirm availability for the day.

faq.q: Can I bundle several small jobs into one visit?
faq.a: That's exactly what this service is built for. Send photos of everything—door, lock, shelf, silicone—and we'll sort them all in a single trip so you're not paying for repeated call-outs.

faq.q: How do I get a price without calling anyone?
faq.a: Send clear photos on WhatsApp with a brief description of the issue. We reply with a quote based on what we see; final cost depends on the job and any parts needed.
